title: Completely
subtitle: 「完全地／徹底地／全然地」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？
description: 「完全地／徹底地／全然地」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？

words.note: 和 completely 最直接、最自然的近義詞之一。
words.example: I entirely agree with your conclusion.

exercises.original: The two proposals are completely different in both cost and design.
exercises.zh: 兩個方案在成本和設計上完全不同。
exercises.upgrade: The two proposals are entirely different in both cost and design.

options.explanation: entirely different 是非常自然的搭配，表示完全不同。
very different 只表示差異很大，不保證完全不同。
表示大部分不同，仍有相同部分。
thoroughly different 不如 entirely different 自然。

exercises.original: Her explanation was completely accurate.
exercises.zh: 她的解釋完全準確。
exercises.upgrade: Her explanation was entirely accurate.

options.explanation: 表示沒有錯誤，完整地準確。
very accurate 是高度準確，不是 100%。
表示「足夠準確」，語義不同。

exercises.original: The project is completely dependent on external funding.
exercises.zh: 這個項目完全依賴外部資金。
exercises.upgrade: The project is entirely dependent on external funding.

options.explanation: entirely dependent on 是自然搭配，表示沒有其他資金來源。
通常不說 highly dependent 來表示 100% 依賴。
大部分依賴，但仍有其他來源。

words.note: 表示某件事達到完整程度，尤其常和理解、發展、運作、恢復等搭配。
words.example: The system is now fully operational.
words.exampleZh: 系統現在已完全投入運作。

exercises.original: The system is completely operational again.
exercises.zh: 系統現在已完全恢復運作。
exercises.upgrade: The system is fully operational again.

options.explanation: fully operational 是固定自然搭配，表示功能完整恢復。

exercises.original: I completely understand the problem now.
exercises.zh: 我現在完全明白這個問題。
exercises.upgrade: I fully understand the problem now.

options.explanation: fully understand 是非常常見的搭配。
absolutely understand 不如 fully understand 自然。

exercises.original: She has completely recovered from the injury.
exercises.zh: 她已完全從傷患中康復。
exercises.upgrade: She has fully recovered from the injury.

options.explanation: 表示大致康復，仍可能有問題。
不如 fully recovered 自然。

words.note: 非常常見、較口語的近義詞。
words.example: I was totally surprised by the result.
words.exampleZh: 結果令我完全感到意外。

exercises.original: I was completely surprised by the result.
exercises.zh: 結果令我完全感到意外。
exercises.upgrade: I was totally surprised by the result.

options.explanation: 口語中非常自然，表示完全出乎意料。
表示很驚訝，不一定完全沒料到。
強度取決於語境，未必等於完全。
表示差點驚訝，語義不合。

exercises.original: The claim is completely false.
exercises.zh: 這項聲稱完全是假的。
exercises.upgrade: The claim is totally false.

options.explanation: 表示沒有任何真實成分。
大部分是錯的，但可能有部分正確。
表示相當合理程度，不合。

exercises.original: Their new approach is completely different from the old one.
exercises.zh: 他們的新方法和舊方法完全不同。
exercises.upgrade: Their new approach is totally different from the old one.

options.explanation: 表示很大程度不同，但不一定完全。
程度高，但仍可能有共同點。

words.note: 語氣很強，常表示完全到極端程度。
words.exampleZh: 這項提案完全不切實際。

exercises.original: The proposal is completely unrealistic and cannot be implemented.
exercises.zh: 這項提案完全不切實際，無法實施。
exercises.upgrade: The proposal is utterly unrealistic.

options.explanation: utterly unrealistic 是非常自然的強烈負面搭配。
只是很不實際，強度較低。
大部分不實際，仍可能有可行部分。
fully unrealistic 不如 utterly unrealistic 自然。
形容詞，不能修飾另一形容詞。

exercises.original: The building was completely destroyed by the fire.
exercises.zh: 建築物被大火徹底摧毀。
exercises.upgrade: The building was utterly destroyed by the fire.

options.explanation: 表示徹底到沒有完整部分剩下。
表示相當程度，不是完全。

exercises.original: She felt completely exhausted after the journey.
exercises.zh: 旅程後她感到筋疲力盡。
exercises.upgrade: She felt utterly exhausted after the journey.

options.explanation: utterly exhausted 是強烈、自然搭配。
程度較弱或依語境而定。
表示「足夠疲累」，不合語義。

words.note: 表示沒有任何保留，或程度達到極致。

exercises.original: I am completely certain that the figures are correct.
exercises.zh: 我完全確定這些數字正確。
exercises.upgrade: I am absolutely certain that the figures are correct.

options.explanation: absolutely certain 是固定搭配，表示毫無疑問。
very certain 只是高度確定。
表示有合理程度的確定，不是絕對。

exercises.original: The answer is completely correct.
exercises.zh: 答案完全正確。
exercises.upgrade: The answer is absolutely correct.

exercises.original: It is completely impossible to finish this in five minutes.
exercises.zh: 要在五分鐘內完成這件事完全不可能。
exercises.upgrade: It is absolutely impossible to finish this in five minutes.

options.explanation: absolutely impossible 是極自然搭配。
very impossible 一般不自然，因 impossible 已是極限形容詞。
nearly impossible 是「幾乎不可能」，未達完全。
在某些英式搭配可很強，但不如 absolutely 明確。

words.note: 較正式、書面，表示整體上完全如此。
words.exampleZh: 這個決定完全出乎意料。

exercises.original: The decision was completely unexpected.
exercises.zh: 這個決定完全出乎意料。
exercises.upgrade: The decision was wholly unexpected.

options.explanation: 正式書面中自然，表示全然沒有預料到。
大體上出乎意料，不如 wholly 完整。
幾乎出乎意料，意思不合。

exercises.original: The company is completely owned by its employees.
exercises.zh: 公司完全由員工持有。
exercises.upgrade: The company is wholly owned by its employees.

options.explanation: wholly owned 是非常常見的商業／法律搭配。
接近全部，但仍不是全部。

exercises.original: The accusation was completely without evidence.
exercises.zh: 這項指控完全沒有證據支持。
exercises.upgrade: The accusation was wholly without evidence.

options.explanation: 正式語氣中可表示完全缺乏證據。
大部分沒有，仍可能有少量。
不能自然修飾 without evidence。

words.note: 在某些語境中可表示 completely，尤其和 different / impossible / unacceptable 等搭配。
words.example: The new situation is altogether different.

exercises.original: The new arrangement is completely different from the previous one.
exercises.zh: 新安排和之前的安排完全不同。
exercises.upgrade: The new arrangement is altogether different from the previous one.

options.explanation: altogether different 是自然搭配，表示完全不同。
兩個詞通常表示「全部一起」，不是此處副詞。

exercises.original: The explanation was completely unacceptable.
exercises.zh: 這個解釋完全不能接受。
exercises.upgrade: The explanation was altogether unacceptable.

options.explanation: 較書面，表示完全不能接受。
意思是「一起」，拼法和意思都不同。

exercises.original: That is a completely separate issue.
exercises.zh: 那是完全不同的另一個問題。
exercises.upgrade: That is an altogether separate issue.

options.explanation: altogether separate 表示完全獨立。
very separate 不如 altogether 自然。

words.note: 強調做得很深入、很全面、沒有遺漏。

exercises.original: The equipment was completely inspected before use.
exercises.zh: 設備在使用前經過徹底檢查。
exercises.upgrade: The equipment was thoroughly inspected before use.

options.explanation: 檢查過程做得全面、仔細，最自然。
entirely inspected 不如 thoroughly inspected 自然。
形容詞，不能修飾動詞 inspected。

exercises.original: The room was completely cleaned before the guests arrived.
exercises.zh: 客人到達前，房間已徹底清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The room was thoroughly cleaned before the guests arrived.

options.explanation: 清潔過程全面、沒有遺漏。

exercises.original: The investigators completely examined every record.
exercises.zh: 調查人員徹底檢查每一份紀錄。
exercises.upgrade: The investigators thoroughly examined every record.

options.explanation: every record + examine 強調深入、全面。
口語上可理解，但 thoroughly examined 搭配更自然。

words.note: 表示從多個方面完整處理或涵蓋某件事。
words.exampleZh: 這個問題已被全面檢討。

exercises.original: The policy was completely reviewed before the vote.
exercises.zh: 政策在投票前被全面檢討。
exercises.upgrade: The policy was comprehensively reviewed before the vote.

options.explanation: reviewed + 多方面完整評估很適合。
也很接近，但更偏仔細深入；comprehensively 更突出涵蓋所有面向。

exercises.original: The report completely covers the main causes and effects.
exercises.zh: 報告全面涵蓋主要成因和影響。
exercises.upgrade: The report comprehensively covers the main causes and effects.

options.explanation: 表示從多個角度完整涵蓋。
也可成立，但 comprehensively covers 更突出廣度。

exercises.original: The risks were completely assessed before construction began.
exercises.zh: 工程開始前，所有風險都已全面評估。
exercises.upgrade: The risks were comprehensively assessed before construction began.

options.explanation: assessment 涵蓋所有主要風險面向。
原詞本身可用，但本題 target 更正式、更強調全面性。

words.note: 固定表達，表示全部、不缺任何部分。
words.example: The report was published in full.

exercises.original: The newspaper published the statement completely.
exercises.zh: 報章完整刊登了聲明全文。
exercises.upgrade: The newspaper published the statement in full.

options.explanation: publish in full 是固定搭配，表示全文、一字不漏。
fully published 不如固定片語自然。
語義可理解，但 published in full 更標準。
形容詞，不能直接修飾 published。

exercises.original: The customer paid the bill completely before leaving.
exercises.zh: 顧客離開前把賬單全數付清。
exercises.upgrade: The customer paid the bill in full before leaving.

options.explanation: pay in full 是固定表達，表示全數付清。
fully paid the bill 可理解，但不如 paid ... in full 自然。

exercises.original: Please read the agreement completely before signing.
exercises.zh: 簽署前請完整閱讀整份協議。
exercises.upgrade: Please read the agreement in full before signing.

options.explanation: 表示從頭到尾全部閱讀。
表示仔細閱讀，重點不同；可以讀得 thoroughly，但未必強調每一部分都看過。

words.note: 較口語，表示一直到最後或完全支持／完成。
words.example: She supported the plan all the way.
words.exampleZh: 她自始至終完全支持這個計劃。

exercises.original: She supported the plan completely from the beginning to the end.
exercises.zh: 她從頭到尾完全支持這個計劃。
exercises.upgrade: She supported the plan all the way.

options.explanation: from the beginning to the end 正好對應全程支持。

exercises.original: He backed the team completely throughout the season.
exercises.zh: 他整個賽季一直全力支持球隊。
exercises.upgrade: He backed the team all the way throughout the season.

options.explanation: 長時間持續到底的支持最自然。
雖可表示完全，但 backed ... altogether 不自然。

exercises.original: We are completely behind you on this decision.
exercises.zh: 在這個決定上，我們完全支持你。
exercises.upgrade: We are behind you all the way on this decision.

options.explanation: 固定口語語氣，表示毫無保留支持。

words.note: 口語強調完全確定、完全支持或完全符合。
words.example: I am one hundred percent certain.

exercises.original: I am completely certain that this is the right decision.
exercises.zh: 我百分之百確定這是正確決定。
exercises.upgrade: I am one hundred percent certain that this is the right decision.

options.explanation: 口語中非常強地表示完全確定。

exercises.original: She is completely committed to the project.
exercises.zh: 她百分之百投入這個項目。
exercises.upgrade: She is one hundred percent committed to the project.

options.explanation: 口語強調毫無保留的投入。

exercises.original: The two versions are completely identical.
exercises.zh: 兩個版本百分之百完全相同。
exercises.upgrade: The two versions are one hundred percent identical.

options.explanation: 口語強調沒有任何差異。
very identical 通常不自然，因 identical 本身是絕對概念。
表示幾乎一樣，但仍有差異。

falseSynonyms.zh: 非常 ≠ 完全 very 只表示程度高，不代表達到 100%。 第二句表示沒有剩下未清潔的部分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The room is very clean. The room is completely clean.

falseSynonyms.zh: 真的／非常 ≠ 完全 really 可以加強語氣，但不保證「完全」。
quite 的程度依方言和語境而變 在英式英語中 quite 有時只是「相當」； 在某些搭配中可接近「完全」，但不穩定，因此不能當作通用同義詞。
大部分 ≠ 全部 mostly 明確表示仍有一部分不是如此。
幾乎 ≠ 完全 almost completely 本身就表示「差一點才完全」。
只有某些過程語境才接近 thoroughly inspect 很自然， 但 thoroughly different 通常不如 completely different 自然。
詞性陷阱 - complete = 形容詞／動詞 - completely = 副詞 - completion = 名詞
字形相近但意思不同 - full = 滿的／完整的 - fully = 完全地 - fulfil = 履行／實現
